clinical_takeaways: Multiple large randomized trials of SGLT2 inhibitors (empagliflozin, canagliflozin, dapagliflozin, sotagliflozin, ertugliflozin) report cardiovascular and renal outcomes in patients with type 2 diabetes.
Lifestyle factors (smoking, alcohol consumption, physical activity, obesity) are associated with heart failure risk and outcomes based on cohort and meta-analysis data cited.
References include major cardiovascular outcome trials and observational/meta-analytic studies relevant to heart failure and diabetes management.
